transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Yeah, nice to meet you too. Um... I guess I'm just here because I've been having some trouble at work lately. For the past year or so, anyway. 

Just... the smallest things keep pulling me off whatever I'm doing. Like a phone buzz, or somebody walking past my office. Sometimes it's not even that, just a random thought about my in-laws or something, and I'm just pulled away from my work before I can even stop it. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Did you have this same kind of trouble focusing when you were a child?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... looking back, it was kind of like that when I was a kid, too. 

Teachers were always... you know, moving my seat around. I guess I talked too much, or I'd get up when I wasn't supposed to. Sometimes I'd just... blurt things out before they even finished asking a question. So, yeah. I guess it's been around for a while.
Do you also get pulled off task like this in other parts of your life, such as at home?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... at home, especially. 

I'll... tell my wife I'm going to call the insurance guy, or maybe pick something up for the house. And then... I don't know, days later she'll ask me about it, and I honestly just forgot all about it. So... yeah. It happens there too.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
No, um... not really. I don't... I don't feel depressed. Just kind of annoyed with myself sometimes, I guess. But no.
Do you often find yourself worrying a lot, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
No, not really. I mean... I don't think so. I don't really sit around worrying about stuff. Just... normal things, I guess. But nothing crazy.
